items.title: James Bond's 'Bare Wrist' Sparks Luxury Watch Scramble... Omega to Defend Its Place or Jaeger-LeCoultre to Replace It?
items.why: Speculation says James Bond going watchless in a new film could shift luxury watch demand between Omega and Jaeger-LeCoultre.
